newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: OSCE delegation to visit Turkey in coming week.
newsitem.headline: OSCE delegation to visit Turkey in coming week.

text.p: A parliamentary delegation from Europe's top security body will visit Turkey next week to review human rights developments and the Cyprus situation, a Swiss parliament statement said on Friday.
The statement said the delegation from the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) parliamentary assembly would be in Turkey from April 28 to May 1.

The team, head by Javier Ruperez, chairman of the Spanish parliament's foreign affairs committee and of the OSCE assembly, will meet Turkish President Suleyman Demirel, Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan and parliamentary speaker Mustafa Kalemli.
It will also visit Lelya Zana and other political prisoners now held in Turkish jails.
Zana received the Sakharov Prize from the European Parliament in 1995 for her work to protect the rights of Kurdish people.

The delegation's visit follows an invitation from the Turkish assembly to review developments in human rights and Turkey's compliance with OSCE guidelines. The OSCE paid a similar visit to Turkey in May, 1995.
The group includes Swiss, Dutch, Swedish and U.S. representatives.
